response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and backend work, current Staff-level title, and directly relevant exposure to AI-agent infrastructure (MCP code generators, agentic workflow frameworks) at re:cinq. He also has genuine high-throughput distributed systems experience from Dunnhumby/Sociomantic (millions of HTTP requests per second, low-latency async services). However, the resume shows no Python — a must-have — with the stack centered on TypeScript/Node and DLang, and there is little evidence of the technical-strategy, cross-functional stakeholder management, or on-call/incident-ownership responsibilities expected at Staff level in this role. Worth a screening conversation to validate Python depth, distributed-systems recency, and scope of influence, but not a clear yes on paper.
strengths: Hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling experience
Proven high-throughput, low-latency microservices at scale
Strong TypeScript/Node plus craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
concerns: No Python evidence despite it being a must-have
Little demonstrated technical strategy or stakeholder leadership
Recent roles skew full-stack product over distributed architecture
